content_metadata.description: A young man with short blond hair, wearing a black t-shirt with a grey Batman logo, struggles with motivation and achieving his fitness goals. Throughout the scenes, he deals with frustration and self-doubt, receiving motivational speeches but ultimately finding solace and focus using a fidget spinner.
